scientific_intent.scientific_task: Genetic optimization of an eight-state finite-state predictor on a binary address trace
scientific_intent.mathematical_method: Block-local populations, exact trace fitness, highest-lane tie selection, mutation/crossover and LCG random states
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Full source1024x256 population,32768-byte state,8-state FSM,cutoff1,repeat10; named shorter traces. Original65536 CLI unmeasured. Training-trace fitness only, no heldout prediction claim.
accuracy_requirements: Exact complete public states and trace fitness against independent sparse-state CPU GA
All262144 final RNG states checked using affine jump and per-lane draw counts
Exact input readback prefix, all five captures and both GPU reference comparisons
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: UInt16 trace, UInt8 FSM/state, UInt32 LCG, Int32 fitness/indices/counts, UInt64 winner atomic; no floating-point device computation
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Controlled irregular stochastic-search operator for studying state-table layout, synchronization and reproducibility. Low-bit RNG diversity and same-trace evaluation limit inference about optimization or predictive quality.
